verdict.rationale: Asking whether an image-conversion tool offers a job-based conversion API is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a local CLI and in-process language bindings for C, C++, Python, .NET and Node.js. These are developer building blocks: nothing documents an endpoint that accepts an upload or URL, tracks a conversion job's status, and returns the output file, and every OpenAPI probe returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented API takes an upload or URL, runs the conversion as a job with visible status, and returns the output file
